name: Attleborough Foodbank
short_description: Local foodbank at St Mary's Church
description: Provides emergency food parcels to residents in crisis. Part of the Norwich Foodbank Network. Open Tuesdays and Fridays 10am-2pm.

name: Attleborough Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Chapel Road with 15 plots
months: this garden provides growing space for residents and runs a seed library for members.

name: Attleborough Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Attleborough Library reducing food waste
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food and access free items. Open Monday-Saturday.
